discourse.excerpt: Let Truth and Love be the goals for all your efforts and studies.
discourse.theme: Truth sustains the world and protects mankind — let Truth and Love be the goals of all our efforts and studies.
discourse.title: Truth and Love - The goals

reflection: Swami says Truth sustains the world and protects mankind, and that the offering God delights in is the flower of prema and the flower of sathyam. Today, speak one truth kindly — softened with love and sympathy — and keep one promise exactly as you made it. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 18, 5 Dec 1985)
seva_nudge: Keep one promise today that would be easy to let slide — your word, kept exactly, is service to Truth itself.
